admission.justification: The ordinary sync exemption must not admit stale authored covers at a leaf publication.

applicability: History-row validation of converted leaf publications and ordinary merges.
conditions: A leaf publication checks every disagreeing row, including merge-moved rows.
exclusions: A merge which is not a leaf publication retains its report-only moved-row lane.
statement: At a leaf publication every disagreeing row refuses, including rows a merge moved; the report-only treatment applies only to non-publication merges.
